title: Stakeholder Need Schema
description: Schema for an elicited stakeholder need (Automotive SPICE SYS.1). A stakeholder need states what a stakeholder wants the item to achieve, in stakeholder language, with the stakeholder identified and the need given a rationale. It is deliberately not a requirement: it carries no threshold, no acceptance criterion and no interface, because a need that already contains those has silently become a requirement and the derivation step is lost.

fictional.description: Machine-pinned to true. No stakeholder in this corpus is a real person, organisation or foxBMS maintainer.

is_a_real_elicitation.description: False for every record in this corpus. No workshop, interview or questionnaire was held. Set to false so a reader cannot mistake a declared need for an elicited one.

elicitation_evidence.description: Required whenever is_a_real_elicitation is true. Empty in this corpus, and that emptiness is the honest state.

operational_situation_refs.description: Operational situations in which the need applies. A need that does not apply in any situation cannot be tested.

derived_requirements.description: Requirement ids this need was refined into. A need with no derived requirement is an unprocessed need, and is stated as such in `limitation`.

validation_measures.description: Validation measures that address this need. Validation must be against stakeholder intent, not a re-run of unit tests.
